headline: Regional Party Enthusiast Accidentally Joins Entirely Wrong Political Rally While Looking for Nearby Cafe
body: A local party loyalist was officially nominated for an Upper House seat this morning after mistakenly walking onto a podium thinking it was the queue for a new artisanal coffee shop. She is expected to serve a six-year term primarily focusing on how to exit the building without anyone noticing the error.
caption: When the line for cold brew is shorter than the line for legislative candidacy. Whoops! #Politics #WestBengal #Oops #PoliticalNews (satire)
igHook: Ever accidentally joined a movement you didn't mean to? Tag a friend who has no idea what they're doing today.
imagePrompt: A wide-angle, realistic shot of a person standing on a generic wooden podium with microphones, appearing slightly confused, while a blurred crowd holds generic colorful flags in the background.
